name: peakclip
description: PeakClip — AI clipping that finds the most-watched moments of any video and turns them into ready-to-post shorts. Powered by Gemini on Vertex AI.

scripts.dev: npm run doctor --silent; concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm:dev -w server" "npm:dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run typecheck -w server
